usedFor: TagMango knows who finished a course, and Documint writes the document when “Course Completion” runs “Add Content To Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “Course Completion” in TagMango, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: A learner finishing a course fills a template, so a certificate or summary is ready to send.

watchOut: “Course Progress Event” fires whenever progress starts, so choose “Course Completion” to avoid documents for partial work.
